sections.title: Sound of the letter ü
paragraphs: The letter (ü) /y/ is called (ü) /y/. Its main sound is the sound /y/, as in the word (üveg) /ˈyvɛɡ/, which means glass, bottle. This letter has one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: To make this vowel, lift your tongue high and forward near the roof of your mouth. Push your lips forward into a small tight circle, like a tunnel. Keep your voice on so your throat shakes. Place a finger before your lips to feel the small round hole they form as you breathe out smoothly.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound /y/ in all positions. You hear it clearly in the word (tűz) /tyːz/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not replace this sound with the vowel in English food. That vowel pulls the tongue back in the mouth. Shape your tongue for the vowel in English see, but round your lips tightly. Do not let your lips glide or change shape while you make the sound.
